name: interactioncombinators
description: Lafont's interaction combinators on a Void Maiz canvas: every gesture and every rewrite is a dispatched, logged, undoable Void Core command, and two people can reduce one net at once.

requires.name: voidmaiz
requires.note: the canvas, gestures, inspector, the reduce executor, the collaboration layer, the phone layout kit and the update client. Void Maiz in turn locates Void Core (../VoidCore) and Void Allomone (../VoidAllomone).

requires.name: voidpalabra
requires.note: sync. Present: the desktop build gains Host/Join and the two-window duo bench. Absent: the app builds solo.

platforms_note: A SHIPPING RECORD, as Void Maiz and Void Hormiga use the field: both were built and handed to a person (0.2.0, 2026-09-21; the author ran the APK on a phone). The Windows build is a portable .zip and the Android build an .apk, not the setup.exe / .tar.gz that `mago feed` names today, so tools/package_release.ps1 fills in the artifact names and hashes after Mago writes the document (asked of Void Mago 2026-09-21).

release.summary: a device that sleeps comes back by itself, nets and people have names, and there is a way to tell whether two screens really agree
adds: Your phone reconnects on its own after it sleeps or the Wi-Fi drops, and the host lets it straight back in without asking again
A profile: your name and colour, kept on this device, shown to everyone you work with (Settings > Profile)
Nets have names. The host names the net (a net is a mantle), and joiners see that name in the list instead of an address
The LAN panel says what this device actually holds (agents, wires, questions) and has a Resync now button that asks for the whole net again

behavior_changes.what: A link with nothing on it for 12 seconds is now treated as dead and says so, instead of claiming to be connected
behavior_changes.who_is_affected: anyone whose device slept while connected

behavior_changes.what: Sharing a net for the first time renames the starter net from 'lafont' to '<your name>-net'
behavior_changes.who_is_affected: anyone who shares the starter net

behavior_changes.what: This device is named by your profile (your computer name by default) rather than 'lafont'
behavior_changes.who_is_affected: anyone reading the log or the member list
